subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group typing semantics?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but only maintainers can choose whether preventing false silent-run typing is worth losing the typing flash on rare proactive unmentioned visible replies.

options.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, adapt it to `conversationKind` and `groupMention`, and keep the authorized-command carve-out and focused coverage.

options.title: Prefer visible delivery typing
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical direction only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep current behavior for now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group typing unchanged until a live repro or UX decision makes the broader suppression clearly worth landing.

recommendation.title: Rebase the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, adapt it to `conversationKind` and `groupMention`, and keep the authorized-command carve-out and focused coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing PR and has recent merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch area.
